title: Physical hydrological target
comment_summary: A self-constructed risk index does not demonstrate hydrological forecasting skill. Replace it with an observed or reanalysis physical quantity, or independently validate disaster impacts.
locations: Abstract; Sections 2.1–2.3, 4.1, 5.1 and 6; Tables 1–5; Figures 1–2 and 4–5.

title: Systematic Sybil evaluation
comment_summary: Seven reports cannot support a general defence claim. Vary attacker count, reputation, spatial/temporal pattern, sparse reports and thresholds, and include numerical comparators.

title: Contribution and prior browser hydrology
comment_summary: Standard temporal attention, forecast combination and DBSCAN are established. Position the integration against browser and edge hydrological work.

title: Strong baselines and adverse results
comment_summary: Avoid selective improvement percentages against a weak moving-average baseline. Retain seasonal decomposition, all constituents and stronger alternatives even when they win.
locations: Abstract; Sections 3.1–3.2 and 4.1–4.3; Tables 4–6, 9–10 and A1.

title: Simulated Typhoon Yagi motivation
comment_summary: Distinguish simulated Yagi scenarios from real event-specific VGI, losses and deployment outcomes.

title: Attention storage terrain and retention ablations
comment_summary: Evaluate attention removal, quantisation error, the terrain factor and reputation retention with appropriate uncertainty.

title: Equation numbering and complete branches
comment_summary: Repair numbering, additive-attention attribution, candidate-state notation and the malformed reputation penalty branch.

title: Parameter justification and sensitivity
comment_summary: Unsupported risk weights and empirical spatial, reputation and decision parameters require reasons and sensitivity analysis.
locations: Sections 3.2 and 3.6–3.8, 4.2 and 4.6; Tables 7 and B1; campaign manifest.

title: Event driven inference and energy evidence
comment_summary: A proposed reduction of battery drain and thermal throttling requires measurements or a narrower claim.

title: Concision author responsibility and AI disclosure
comment_summary: Shorten repetitive writing and classical derivations, ensure human scientific review and correct the generative-AI declaration.
locations: Entire manuscript; Author and publishing declarations.

title: Physical quantities and scope
comment_summary: Replace dimensionless risk-index errors with physical hydrological evaluation or narrow every claim, including the Abstract.

title: Expected MSE and ensemble benchmarking
comment_summary: Include forecast bias, describe covariance estimation and constraints, and report comparisons against seasonal decomposition, LSTM and strong baselines.
locations: Sections 3.1–3.2, 4.1–4.2 and 5.2; Equations 1–2; Tables 4–7, A1 and B1.

title: Neutral reputation attacks and numerical baselines
comment_summary: Sweep attacker counts and neutral initial reputation, report false and missed alerts, include majority and discuss observed failures.

title: Offline local processing and report transport
comment_summary: Explain how verification operates with zero connectivity and identify transport or reconciliation requirements without implying shared offline consensus.

title: Simulated Yagi and deployment readiness
comment_summary: Label every Yagi reference as simulation and withdraw claims of community use, completed pilots or operational capability.

title: Unsupported index and terrain parameters
comment_summary: Justify empirical index weights and undefined slope/elevation coefficients or remove them and quantify remaining assumptions.

title: Prominent limitations in the Abstract
comment_summary: The Abstract must disclose the observational, geographic, simulation and deployment limitations.

title: Aim before research questions
comment_summary: Place one concise research-aim statement immediately before the three research questions.

title: Repeated training and chronological reproducibility
comment_summary: Provide repeated-seed uncertainty, exact partitions and matched LSTM ablation hyperparameters; remove the inconsistent split description.
locations: Sections 2.3, 3.3 and 3.8; Tables 3–6, 9–10; complete source tables.

title: Equation housekeeping
comment_summary: Repair equation cross-references, candidate-state notation, the penalty branch and the attention citation.

title: Temporal attention and calibrated defence terminology
comment_summary: Either implement a spatial mechanism or rename the model, and replace unrestricted confidence/defence claims with scenario-specific results.

title: Input channels and miscellaneous citation details
comment_summary: Explain earthquake/tsunami inputs, remove unnecessary year letters, correct INFORM attribution and Adger, cite or remove Abozweita, and unify availability statements.
locations: Sections 3.1 and 3.6; References; Data and code availability; responses R2 L1–L4 and S1.

title: Balanced Discussion and supported literature comparison
comment_summary: Synthesise relevant verified literature and operational boundaries instead of repeating favourable results; discuss the relationship to reporting and server-side systems.

title: Verifiable desktop execution and memory
comment_summary: Retain useful feasibility measurements with identifiable workloads, devices, numerical equivalence and correctly defined memory.

title: Correct Sit and Adger metadata
comment_summary: Correct the author/venue of the Sit review and the exact title of Adger’s article, with DOI or stable URL.

title: Attention combination and browser sources
comment_summary: Attribute additive attention correctly, acknowledge Bates–Granger, and cite direct browser hydrology precedents.

title: Unverifiable entries and inconsistent keys
comment_summary: Remove articles that cannot be verified as cited; a real author or a different paper does not validate a disputed reference.

title: Verify and cite Abozweita
comment_summary: Verify Abozweita et al. (2024) and cite it in the text or remove the uncited entry.

title: Retraction screening remains distinct
comment_summary: Do not report an inconclusive screening state as a clean retraction record; distinguish metadata and full-text verification.
locations: Reference scope in Sections 1 and 5; bibliography audit records.

title: Repository and a single availability statement
comment_summary: Retain the real GitHub asset in Methods, consolidate availability statements and remove the obsolete anonymous link.

title: Weights configurations traces and actual availability
comment_summary: Ensure the exact products underlying the tables are present before asserting public availability, including weights and configuration files.
locations: Section 4; Data and code availability; complete result CSVs, configurations, weights, traces and audits.
